notes.subject: fix(credentials): release the mutation lock when its owner write fails
notes.summary: Fixes a bug where a failed disk write while creating the keychain mutation lock left a stale lock behind, which blocked Codex sign-in and token refresh until the lock was removed by hand.

notes.subject: feat(models): add GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, GPT-Image-2.6 for generate_image
notes.summary: Adds GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to the Codex/OpenAI model picker. Also makes GPT-Image-2.6 Flare the default for generate_image, adds a complexity option, a served_image_tool field and the agentlink.imageGeneration.credential setting, and rejects input_fidelity earlier.
